2) LIVING MODEL / MODEL GENERATION — GO, existing workstream resumed with a NEW genuine Claude Cloud execution session because prior owner is gone.

3) SCI-TEMPORAL / UNCERTAINTY — GO, existing workstream resumed with a NEW genuine Claude Cloud execution session because prior owner is gone.

4) SCI-CHANGE / SCIENCE ENGINE — assign existing live C/SCI-HERO owner01a0feed explicitly.
Refresh current ISL#220 → PLoT#431 → CEE#2522 chain; fix current correctness defects first, then finish the supported link-level what-would-change-this path. Do not shape VOI for demo positivity.

5) SCI-DEEP / STRUCTURAL ROBUSTNESS — NEW WORKSTREAM: authorised to brief/spin up as a bounded genuine Claude Cloud lane once DL posts the split brief.
Scope starts with Structural Robustness / Challenge this only; no broad new science engine, no background generation, no speculative ontology.

6) UNIFIED WORKSPACE / UI — existing Canvas owner01a0f787 continues Compare923 and then surfaces supported science/reasoning/artefact outputs through existing UI patterns. No new renderer/state authority.

7) HARNESS + EXECUTOR — existing owners continue continuously; they verify/serve increments but do not impose a programme-wide stop on disjoint work.

Operating rule: maximum file/authority-disjoint concurrency; one writer per hotspot; no clock train; merge/serve as soon as coherent.
